title: Convex Physics Informed Neural Networks for the Monge-Amp\`ere Optimal Transport Problem
abstract: arXiv:2501.10162v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Optimal transportation of raw material from suppliers to customers is an issue arising in logistics that is addressed here with a continuous model relying on optimal transport theory. A physics informed neural network method is advocated here for the solution of the corresponding generalized Monge-Amp\`ere equation. Convex neural networks are advocated to enforce the convexity of the solution to the Monge-Amp\`ere equation and obtain a suitable approximation of the optimal transport map. A particular focus is set on the enforcement of transport boundary conditions in the loss function. Numerical experiments illustrate the solution to the optimal transport problem in several configurations, and sensitivity analyses are performed.

translated_title: 用于Monge-Ampère最优传输问题的凸物理信息神经网络
translated_abstract: 将原材料从供应商运输到客户的最优运输是物流领域中出现的问题，本文采用基于最优传输理论的连续模型来解决该问题。本文提倡使用物理信息神经网络方法来求解相应的广义Monge-Ampère方程。为强制Monge-Ampère方程解的凸性并获得最优传输映射的合适近似，本文采用了凸神经网络。研究特别关注在损失函数中对传输边界条件的强制执行。数值实验展示了多种配置下最优传输问题的求解结果，并进行了敏感性分析。
tldr: 本文提出用凸物理信息神经网络求解Monge-Ampère方程，通过凸神经网络结构保证解的凸性并特别在损失函数中处理传输边界条件，从而有效近似最优传输映射。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes convex physics-informed neural networks for solving the Monge-Ampère equation, enforcing solution convexity through convex network architectures with particular focus on transport boundary conditions in the loss function, to obtain suitable approximations of the optimal transport map.
